text:
Mira (Product): quick UX tidy: compliance says users can't find Region vs Key owner. Should Region be a persistent badge or stay in Data protection card? mock: https://rwd.example/s/region-key :thinking:
Owen (Design): badge in header wins discoverability. tradeoff: header density. alternative: tiny header pill + full details in card.
Rex (Frontend): header pill means extra metadata fetches. we can lazy-load but expect a flash. Also retention null state shows '30 days' today; should be explicit: 'Default retention: 30 days' vs 'Retention: 7 days (account override)'.
Lina (A11y): if Region moves, tie it with aria-describedby to Data protection heading so screen readers keep context. tooltips must be keyboard-focusable buttons, not just hover.
Mira (Product): proposal approved: header small pill: 'Region: US-West' (hover: 'Primary storage region for this account'). Data protection card: 'Encryption: Managed key — AcmeCorp  Manage'.
Owen (Design): I'll update mocks including narrow breakpoint and show timezone as small secondary text in audit rows.
Rex (Frontend): audit logs: show local time in UI, hover reveals UTC. Export: include both timestamp_local and timestamp_utc columns; change button label to 'Download audit CSV' with helper 'includes local + UTC timestamps'.
Lina (A11y): export dialog must announce file format and column headers. when encryption toggles, use aria-live polite: 'Encryption updated to Managed key (AcmeCorp)'.
docs-bot: docs task created: DOC-715 'Audit CSV: document local + UTC timestamp columns'.
Mira (Product): final copy to add to style guide: region tooltip — 'Primary storage region for this account'; retention helper — 'Default retention: 30 days (account policy may override)'; export helper — 'Includes local and UTC timestamps'. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
